tools.name: sample_reading
tools.description: What was the US market regime at the last close? Returns the newest settled Regime Card reading, the same one regimecard.com shows: a score from 0 to 100, one of five regimes, the eight cross-asset category labels, and the paid routes with their prices. Free. One reading per US trading day, settled

tools.name: live_reading
tools.description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Returns the live Regime Card reading: a score from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on) and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On, built from eight cross-asset signals, beside the last settled close. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Po

tools.name: stress_gate
tools.description: Is it time to reduce risk or hedge? Credit, volatility and rate stress in one call. Returns the Regime Card stress gate: the overall state (Calm, Elevated or Stressed), how many of its three components are confirmed (N of 3), and the state of each component (Credit, Volatility, Rates: Clear or Confi

tools.name: lookup_symbols
tools.description: How has this stock or crypto typically done in markets like today's? Returns, for one stock or crypto symbol per call (any US stock, plus the covered crypto list), its typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months from the current regime. tools.name: crypto_regime
tools.description: Is crypto risk-on or risk-off, and what does bitcoin risk look like in markets like today's? Returns the current crypto market regime and each covered coin's typical return and how often it rose over 1, 2 and 3 months when the period started in this regime, as historical odds. $0.05 per call in USDC
